propositions: The standing completion-verifier eval constructs a single PydanticAIRunner before entering per-case disposable repositories, causing its LLMConfig.repo_path to remain rooted at the eval checkout.

Per-case filesystem and ticket tools read the checkout root instead of each case's disposable fixture repository because _effective_config preserves the base runner repo_path rather than re-rooting to the case store.

The agent's read_file operations fail to locate fixture code files (e.g. src/cli.py, app/profile.py) in disposable repositories because the runner's filesystem tools are initialized against the wrong checkout root.

The fix re-roots the injected PydanticAIRunner at each disposable case store within the case_store arm via _rerooted, preserving model overrides and clearing tickets_path so agentic tools read the fixture store not the checkout.
